statements.status_notes: The fix for CVE-2026-118773 is glob 14.0.2. No 11.x release contains the fix, and the glob 11.1.0 copy in Uptime Kuma is pinned as a transitive dependency of its npm tree. Adopting glob 14.x is a semver-major upgrade with breaking-change risk, so it is deferred. Reachability of the resource-consumption path in the shipped runtime is under assessment; this statement will be revisited when the major upgrade is evaluated.
